subject: Renewal kickoff: staffing, capacity and stakeholder map
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@novamed.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff: staffing, capacity and stakeholder map

Hi Elaine / team,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off the renewal planning for NovaMed (DEAL-78234). I wanted to get a single thread going to align on timeline, stakeholders and immediate next steps so we have clear handoffs going into the QBR.

High-level timeline (proposed)
- Week of Jun 23: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft + capacity estimate review
- Week of Jul 7: Legal/pricing redlines + procurement checklist
- Week of Jul 14: Exec QBR (30–45 mins) and signoff window

Key asks for this week
1) Elaine — can you confirm the final list of internal decision-makers (execs, procurement, security) who should attend the QBR?
2) Procurement — please share the standard PO cadence and any specific contract clause templates we should expect to see.
3) Marissa / David — can you validate the attached capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx against last quarter's top workloads? I flagged areas where we recommend stair-stepped uplifts.

Proposed QBR windows (Pacific time)
- Tue Jul 15, 09:00–09:45 or
- Wed Jul 16, 16:00–16:45
If neither works, share two alternatives and we’ll lock the calendar.

Attachments: capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx, mutual_action_plan_draft.docx (draft MAP has initial milestones). I also added a HubSpot link and a shared Drive folder in case legal/procurement want direct artifact access.

Short-term owner map (please correct/add):
- Customer exec sponsor: Elaine Torres (NovaMed)
- Redwoods AE: Jasmine Liu
- Renewal lead / CSM ops: Marissa Cole
- Technical capacity lead: David Kim
- Pricing / legal touch: Sergio Alvarez
- Onboarding/CS: Monica Patel

Thanks — if we can get the attendee list and procurement contact by Friday (Jun 20) I’ll circulate the MAP and lock the QBR invite.

Best,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
---
Attachments referenced: capacity_estimate_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48 KB), mutual_action_plan_draft.docx (docx, 32 KB)
From: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@novamed.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: staffing, capacity and stakeholder map

Thanks Jasmine — this is great. Quick answers:
- I’ll be the exec sponsor and want to include our Head of AI Ops (Markus Jensen) and VP Product (Priya Shah) on the QBR. I’ll loop them in once you have a proposed slot.
- Procurement contact is procurement@novamed.com (copied). Our standard timeline is 2–3 weeks for low-touch renewals; if there are term changes or new data clauses it can push to 4–6 weeks.
- Security will likely ask for the SOC 2 + network diagram; I don’t expect a heavy review but we’ll surface it early.

Proposed QBR window preference: Wed Jul 16, 16:00 PT.

I reviewed the capacity workbook at a glance — the uplifts for inference peak look reasonable. I’ll ask Mark and Priya to confirm stakeholder availability; we can treat the MAP as working draft.

Elaine
Elaine Torres
Director of Platform Engineering, NovaMed
elaine.torres@novamed.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@novamed.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: staffing, capacity and stakeholder map

Looping in quick ops notes after reviewing the workbook:
- David, the flagged windows on rows 14–18 assume 8k token average sequences for the health-check flows; we should confirm with NovaMed whether they expect longer LLM dialogues for the new cohort. If so we need to add ~12% headroom.
- Monica, if QBR lands on Wed Jul 16 16:00 PT I’ll prepare the ops readout deck and the 1-slide risk register (latency, burst headroom, compliance items).
- Sergio, pricing: I recommend we present a two-option path during QBR (1) 12-month term with stair-step commit and (2) 24-month term with deeper pricing and a modest onboarding credit. Elaine — please let us know if NovaMed prefers a single-path discussion.

Action items assigned:
- Marissa: ops deck + risk slide (due Jul 10)
- David: confirm token distribution sample (due Jun 24)
- Sergio: draft two-option commercial bullets (due Jun 26)
- Jasmine: lock QBR invite and finalize attendee list (due Jun 20)

I’ll also drop a short runbook into the Drive folder for the call.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Renewal Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: staffing, capacity and stakeholder map

Thanks all — confirming we’ll proceed toward Wed Jul 16, 16:00 PT for the QBR (invites forthcoming from Jasmine). A couple notes from legal/pricing:
- We’ll prepare a redlines tracker and a clean term sheet to present during the QBR. I’ll include an optional clause set for data retention and encryption for NovaMed’s review.
- For procurement: if NovaMed goes 24 months we can allocate a one-time onboarding credit up to $15k and a tiered unit price starting at $0.0045/token for the committed band.

Links I’m putting in the thread:
- Contract tracker (internal): https://drive.google.com/document/d/contract-tracker-example
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/78234

Jasmine — I’ll follow up with a short legal evidence checklist (SOC2 + network diagram + subprocessor list) so Elaine has those items consolidated for her security team.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
